title: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO Details
intro:
Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO is a book build issue of ₹183.06 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 2.23 crore shares of ₹183.06 crore.

Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 29, 2026 and will close on Nov 2, 2026. The allotment for the Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 3, 2026. Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 5, 2026.

Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO is set issue price band at ₹78 to ₹82 per share. The lot size for an application is 182 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,924 (182 shares) (based on upper price).

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Incorporated in December 2019, Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited is a steel processing centre engaged in converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products for Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) and Original Design Manufacturers (“ODMs”). The Company specialises in precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing and embossing of steel coils to manufacture slit coils, embossed slit coils, blanks, embossed blanks and sheared blanks. Its products serve multiple end-use industries, including home and commercial appliances, automotive and auto components, electrical equipment, pharmaceutical cleanroom infrastructure, ventilation systems and general engineering. In addition to processing steel coils, the Company provides logistics and inventory management services and supports customers through just-in-time delivery solutions.

The Company operates four strategically located manufacturing facilities at Wada and Bhiwandi in Maharashtra, Ghiloth in Rajasthan, and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh. Spread across an aggregate area of 42,209 square metres, these facilities are equipped with slitting, cut-to-length, shearing and embossing lines. The Company has an authorised service partnership with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited (“JSWSCPL”) and/or its holding company since 2021, supporting regular access to steel coils. As of June 30, 2026, its aggregate installed processing capacity was 1,23,153 metric tonnes per annum, calculated on a quarterly basis for Fiscal 2027.

The Company serves a diversified customer base across consumer durables, home appliances, refrigeration, automotive, electrical equipment, electronics, industrial engineering and other manufacturing sectors. Its customers include OEMs and ODMs such as Haier Appliances India Private Limited, IFB Refrigeration Limited, Dixon Electro Manufacturing Private Limited, Amber Enterprises India Limited and Western Refrigeration Private Limited.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 164 personnel, comprising 160 permanent employees and 4 employees on retainership.

Bombay Coated & Special Steels Ltd.'s revenue increased by 20% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 7% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.question: When is Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Nov 5, 2026 .
